_schema.FAVOURITE: object (required) - stable catalogue favourite { name, viewId (<=36), containerId (<=36) }; reused every run because LM never deletes catalogue rows
_schema.SCOPED_FAVOURITE: object (required) - stable catalogue favourite created with isScopeEnabled true
_schema.PROCESS_ENTITY_ID: string (required) - synthetic untyped (process linkEntityId style) entity
_schema.SECOND_PROCESS_ENTITY_ID: string (required) - second untyped entity sharing the same catalogue row
_schema.RESERVED_CHAR_ENTITY_ID: string (required) - entity id with URL-reserved characters (space and &)
_schema.UNKNOWN_ENTITY_ID: string (required) - entity id that never has favourites
_schema.SUBPROCESS_TYPE: string (required) - typed favourite entity type for subprocesses
_schema.ACTOR_TYPE: string (required) - interactive cluster actor entity type
_schema.UNKNOWN_FAVOURITE_ID: string (required) - favourite id that does not exist
_schema.LONG_VIEW_ID_LENGTH: number (required) - viewId length over the 36-character limit
_schema.LONG_NAME_LENGTH: number (required) - name length over the 100-character limit
_schema.INVALID_JSON_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for a request body that is not valid JSON
